note: Which RFC 3161 authorities tools/tsa.mjs asks for a token on every new signed head (docs/legal-time.md). None of these is a qualified eIDAS time-stamping service: their tokens are evidence of time without the legal presumption Article 41(2) of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 gives a qualified one. To add a qualified authority, the owner contracts one, adds it here with qualified: true and the address of its entry on the EU Trusted List (trusted_list), and puts its credentials in the GitHub secret named by auth_env.
